# Contracts: default

The contracts that ship with AI-Lore. These files are not edited in place, and an upgrade of AI-Lore replaces them as a whole. To change one, write a file with the same name in the folder above this one, and add its line to that folder's index. The Space's file is then used instead of the default.

A contract is a default when it says how a Space works well rather than what keeps it safe. The contracts that no Space may replace are in `core/`.

- [spec-before-breakdown.md](./spec-before-breakdown.md): a unit of work that has a spec has no breakdown until the spec is agreed; guards Specifying, and has only a rule.
